record.where: The dead boot law (v3.28b — the frozen-input report answered at the ROOT)

clauses.text: the commit
Death is COMMITTED the moment it happens: die() stores the certificate's facts on the save (S.deadInfo) and saves at once
die() set dead:true and showed the Certificate of Passage
no alt-F4 resurrection; the Zomboid doctrine with teeth
the dead boot into the Certificate
A save carrying a committed death boots INTO the Certificate
the fallback text
(older dead saves that lack the facts get an honest fallback: "the road took them between saves")
the backup slot
Before load() reads a byte, the save as it stood is stashed whole in a backup slot (waylight_save_v1_bak)
valley continuity across the handoff
the ceremony hands off to char-gen
and the next walker takes a valley EXACTLY as it was left — likes, structures, graves, legacy, all proven untouched by the suite
live boots after
the watchdog heal
any zombie world it ever meets (dead walker, no certificate on screen) is presented the ceremony within ~2s

figure.note: the certificate is on screen within 2.0 s of the game's own clock (each frame's step, capped as the loop caps it)

clauses.text: the diag line
The ESC menu carries a live diagnostic line naming every gate holding the boots ("boots: held by a scene · a slowed clock")
the release and its no-deletion proof
and FREE MY BOOTS — a release that clears stuck transient state
closes every sheet, and DELETES NOTHING
nothing is ever deleted as fixing
a committed death is not "released" but finally shown its certificate
the fault chip
a pinned chip spells the diagnosis verbatim (⚠ FAULT EVERY FRAME · the sim: <message> · ESC → FREE MY BOOTS)
and the attic's round-trip restore
they now go to THE ATTIC — kept in the save, out of the sim — and step back into the world the moment a build that knows their type loads it
deadboot re-proves the ledger round-trip
DATA.MIGRATE_TYPES is the standing law that a type is forever (any future rename ships its map entry in the same edit), load() walks every save through it at ONE seam

a type past the map becomes a real unmapped world object — authored tarp-and-rope glyph, visible, inert, original type carried on the object — that steps back into itself the moment a build that knows it loads the save
No attic, no splice

checks.title: THE BACKUP SLOT — the no-purge law

design.what: the plain names: the Certificate of Passage is the Death certificate
the plain names: Free my boots is Unstick, its button Release
the chip names the release as the menu shows it: · ESC → UNSTICK
the type ledger replaced the attic: the round trip is the unmapped object's — saved with its original type, back to itself when a build that knows the type loads the save

no attic: a type past the map stands in the world as a real, visible, inert unmapped object (an old save's attic drains back into the world), and still steps back into itself under a build that knows it
